title: Kavieng Airport landowners’ sit-in over unpaid compensation
location: Kavieng Airport, Kavieng, New Ireland Province, Papua New Guinea
threshold_50_evidence: A sit-in by airport landowners is reported, but no source located so far estimates the number present; whether at least 50 people assembled remains pending.

title.summary: The contemporary report identifies the landowners’ sit-in at Kavieng Airport.

start_date.summary: The January 13 report says the sit-in began Monday, January 11, 2021.

start_precision.summary: The report gives a weekday and publication date sufficient to identify January 11.

end_date.summary: The contemporary report establishes the sit-in was still active on January 13. An April 2021 compensation report does not describe protest activity, so it cannot establish when the sit-in physically ended.

location.summary: The report locates the sit-in at Kavieng Airport in New Ireland Province; no more precise site is given.

scope.summary: The reported sit-in is at one airport and described as an action of local landowners.

organizer.summary: The report identifies a chairperson of the landowners’ group; formal organization name is not stated.

demands.summary: The landowners sought payment of agreed compensation for airport redevelopment on their lands.

participants_original.summary: The report calls participants landowners but publishes no attendance estimate.

participants_min.summary: No numeric lower bound is reported.

participants_max.summary: No numeric upper bound is reported.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: A sit-in is established, but neither source gives an attendance figure; the 50-person threshold remains unresolved.

protester_violence.summary: Neither source establishes whether participants used violence; code unknown.

accommodation.summary: The sources do not establish this response during the sit-in; code unknown.

arrests.summary: The sources do not establish this response during the sit-in; code unknown.

beatings.summary: The sources do not establish this response during the sit-in; code unknown.

crowd_dispersal.summary: The sources do not establish this response during the sit-in; code unknown.

ignore.summary: The sources do not establish this response during the sit-in; code unknown.

killings.summary: The sources do not establish this response during the sit-in; code unknown.

shootings.summary: The sources do not establish this response during the sit-in; code unknown.

eligibility.summary: The sit-in and domestic-government compensation demand are reported, but attendance remains unverified, so eligibility is pending_threshold.

notes: Amnesty International’s 2021/22 country section places the sit-in in January 2021. The contemporary January 13 report says it began January 11 and was continuing. The event is a local landowners’ action; the reporting indicates an unresolved compensation campaign but does not establish an end date. The April 2021 compensation report is campaign context only; it does not report whether the sit-in continued.
open_questions: How many people were physically present, and did attendance reach 50?
